newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Hanoi awaits China's reply on fate of patrol boats.
newsitem.headline: Hanoi awaits China's reply on fate of patrol boats.

text.p: Vietnam said on Friday that it was still awaiting a reply on the fate of two patrol boats captured by a Chinese vessel in the Gulf of Tonkin in mid-December.
"We have not yet received any reply from the Chinese side," a foreign ministry spokesman said in a statement.
The authorities have given little information about the incident, although it was clear from the ministry's first statement two weeks ago that both vessels and their crews were missing.
The Lao Dong newspaper said the two vessels, on an anti-smuggling patrol, had discovered and stopped a boat which was illegally shipping goods to China off the northern islands of Co To.

"Fifteen minutes later, while crew members of both patrol boats were making checks in the smuggling boat, a big ship with weapons came and started shooting to rescue the boat which had been captured..." it said.
Lao Dong said the armed ship then captured the two patrol vessels and 14 people on board, but two crew members escaped on a lifeboat and returned to the Vietnamese mainland.
